products.title: Black Forden Tin
products.body_html:
Store Your Pouches in Style 

Redefine your snus experience with our high-end metal can. Designed for ZYN, Rogue, and VELO, it offers superior durability and sleek finishes—keeping your pouches fresh and your look on point.

PRODUCT FEATURES

DUAL-COMPARTMENT DESIGN

Our pouch holder with dual compartments lets you discreetly store both fresh and used snus on the go, keeping it organized, secure, and private. No more searching for the nearest trash can.

YOUR PERFECT EVERYDAY CARRY

With its compact and lightweight design, our metal container is intended for easy portability, making it the perfect everyday accessory for snus users.

STURDY AND BUILT TO ENDURE

Crafted from tough premium metal with a durable anodized finish, our tin is built for daily use, combining toughness and style for the perfect snus storage solution.

DETAILS

DIMENSIONS

Ø: 2.76" x H: 0.87"

CAPACITY

47.5 ml (~20 Pouches)

MATERIALS

6063 ALUMINUM ALLOY

High-quality, durable, lightweight, and corrosion-resistant, offering an excellent strength-to-weight ratio, making it the ideal material for durability and functionality.

TYPE II ANODIZING

Increased surface hardness, improved wear resistance, and better aesthetic qualities with a range of colors, all while maintaining the metal's lightweight properties and structural integrity.
